paragraph__1.content: Welcome to Éclaté. These steps make your store match the demo:

paragraph__3.content: Online Store › Navigation: build a Main menu (e.g. Shop, The Formula, Journal, Our World) and a Footer menu. Nested links become dropdowns.

paragraph__5.content: Settings › Custom data › Products: add the optional metafields custom.subtitle, custom.highlights (list), custom.ingredients, custom.how_to_use, custom.results, custom.skin_type (list), custom.size and custom.badge. Connect them to blocks with the dynamic-source button.

paragraph__7.content: Install Shopify Search & Discovery to add collection filters and pick complementary products for 'Pair it with'.

paragraph__9.content: Install a reviews app (Judge.me, Okendo, Shopify Product Reviews…). Ratings appear automatically; add the app block to the Reviews section on product pages.
